findings.acceptance: NO_COLOR, TERM=dumb, non-TTY and unsupported-color terminals emit no ANSI control codes
findings.summary: Unknown TERM names containing 256color or ending in -color still enable ANSI.
findings.detail: With stdout as a TTY, NO_COLOR absent, and TERM not equal to dumb, the broad substring/suffix checks return true for arbitrary names such as mystery-256color or mystery-color. These are static examples from the condition, not runtime observations; the name alone does not establish ANSI support.
findings.requested_change: Make detection fail closed for unrecognized terminal capability values; enable ANSI only for recognized terminals or explicit capability signals.

acceptance_results.terminal_table: Met by static inspection; ANSI padding accounts for the full opening and reset sequence for the mapped palette. Runtime visual alignment was not checked.
acceptance_results.active_and_archived_sources: Met by static inspection: fd_list_rows uses all_files, which combines active_files and archived_files, and extracts fields from FD documents.
acceptance_results.redundant_color: Met by static inspection: ANSI wrapping is applied only to status and priority values; disabled color returns original text.
acceptance_results.color_fallbacks: Partially met: NO_COLOR, TERM=dumb, and non-TTY disable color; arbitrary unknown TERM names matching broad suffix heuristics can enable ANSI.
acceptance_results.safe_title_rendering: Met by static inspection: Cc/Cf characters are filtered and unrepresentable characters use backslashreplace.
acceptance_results.read_only_and_dependencies: Met by static inspection: list rendering reads FD files and prints output; unicodedata is in the standard library.
